fact: Tech Review Africa reports NCT South Sudan and Bayobab moved into the execution phase, with official kickoff of the National Backbone Fiber Network Project about one month before the 2026-03-04 article, including the Juba to Nadapal eastern segment at the Kenya border.
World Bank Digital Economy Assessment states South Sudan lacks a national fiber backbone; no as-of date given in the statement, so the June 2022 publication date is used.
